title: To Share or Not To Share: Navigating Disclosure and Stigma Among Family Caregivers of Autistic Young Adults_Group Intervention
official: To Share or Not To Share: Navigating Disclosure and Stigma Among Family Caregivers of Autistic Young Adults_Group Intervention
summary: This study is a caregiver support program for family caregivers of autistic young adults (ages 18 to 26) as their family members navigate young adulthood. The program includes six 60-minute virtual sessions focused on making sense of caregiving roles during young adulthood, reflecting on everyday family experiences, supporting decision-making within families, deciding when and how to share experiences with others, and thinking about the future.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Has a family member aged 18-26 who has received an autism-related diagnosis from a healthcare professional
* Must be a primary caregiver for this family member
* Must be able to speak, understand, and read English well
* Participants will be able to provide consent themselves.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lack of proficiency in English
* Not a primary caregiver for a family member with autism aged 18-26
* Individuals requiring a guardian to provide consent will be excluded
